limitations: The three smoke artifacts do not bind source, binary, or model digests, so they are feasibility observations rather than reproducible qualification evidence.
The output-cap changes are withdrawn feasibility probes and must not be used to tune or support the primary claim.
The 1B v3 run is secondary because the designated primary model is 3B and the fixture is synthetic; it has no live coding or repository-execution evidence.
The 1B cluster p-value is unadjusted, uses repeated seeds within 16 base-task clusters, and is structurally degenerate because every cluster comparison favors the deterministic wrapper.
The 1B manifest lacks a v2 dependency/gate/probe hash binding; no raw prompts, contexts, token IDs, database contents, or credentials are included here.
